name: sawbuck-reins
description: Sawbuck in Claude Code, one install: the guide band (watching / N caught / last verdict) plus slash commands, /sawbuck-reins:contract (one step: sign the repo and start watching), /sawbuck-reins:check (try it now), /sawbuck-reins:audit (find rules that pull against each other), /sawbuck-reins:rules (propose the rules you keep enforcing), /sawbuck-reins:shape (what you push on, and what you never said), /sawbuck-reins:context (ranked history for the files you touch), /sawbuck-reins:debt (the repo's live suppression debt), and /sawbuck-reins:status (the inventory). The mod itself runs no program.

judge.title: Live steering judge (off by default, will be removed)
judge.description: Off by default: /sawbuck-reins:rules and /sawbuck-reins:shape read your history when you ask, with no call per turn. native turns on a live steer rate, with one small call per turn through Claude Code's own model API on your plan.

band.title: Guide band
band.description: Show the guide band above your prompt. Set to off if you show sawbuck in your own statusline instead (sawbuck statusline, below the prompt), so it does not appear twice.
